attachment_parent_check.name: attachment_parent_check
attachment_parent_check.value: ("report_attachments"."report_id" is not null)::integer + ("report_attachments"."draft_id" is not null)::integer = 1

reports_handler_category_check.name: reports_handler_category_check
reports_handler_category_check.value: ("reports"."category" = 'kehilangan-temuan' and "reports"."handler_role" = 'satpam') or ("reports"."category" = 'fasilitas' and "reports"."handler_role" = 'teknisi') or ("reports"."category" = 'layanan' and "reports"."handler_role" in ('manajemen', 'tefa')) or ("reports"."category" = 'lainnya' and "reports"."handler_role" = 'manajemen')

reports_status_category_check.name: reports_status_category_check
reports_status_category_check.value: "reports"."status" in ('baru', 'diproses', 'selesai', 'ditolak') or ("reports"."category" = 'fasilitas' and "reports"."status" = 'diverifikasi') or ("reports"."category" = 'kehilangan-temuan' and "reports"."status" in ('barang_teridentifikasi', 'diserahkan'))

found_notice_read_source_check.name: found_notice_read_source_check
found_notice_read_source_check.value: ("found_notice_reads"."report_id" is not null)::integer + ("found_notice_reads"."inventory_id" is not null)::integer = 1

handover_source_check.name: handover_source_check
handover_source_check.value: ("report_handovers"."match_id" is not null)::integer + ("report_handovers"."inventory_id" is not null)::integer = 1

handover_actor_check.name: handover_actor_check
handover_actor_check.value: "report_handovers"."legacy" or ("report_handovers"."actor_id" is not null and "report_handovers"."officer_id" is not null)

handover_inventory_evidence_check.name: handover_inventory_evidence_check
handover_inventory_evidence_check.value: "report_handovers"."inventory_id" is null or "report_handovers"."legacy" or (length(trim("report_handovers"."ownership_evidence")) between 1 and 1000 and "report_handovers"."submission_key" is not null and "report_handovers"."submission_fingerprint" is not null)

handover_loss_source_check.name: handover_loss_source_check
handover_loss_source_check.value: "report_handovers"."loss_report_id" is null or "report_handovers"."inventory_id" is not null

handover_contact_check.name: handover_contact_check
handover_contact_check.value: "report_handovers"."legacy" or ("report_handovers"."handed_over_at" < timestamp with time zone '2026-11-06 17:00:00+07') or (length(trim(coalesce("report_handovers"."recipient_email", ''))) > 0 or length(trim(coalesce("report_handovers"."recipient_phone", ''))) > 0)
